description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment composition, adaptive candidate repair and compact solver outcome learning for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

solverOutcomeIndex.purpose: Persist compact generation outcomes so diagnostic repair heuristics can be calibrated from observed solver success instead of remaining hand-authored.
solverOutcomeIndex.privacyAndSizePolicy: Do not retain generated solution geometry or program payloads; keep canonical identities, diagnostics, repair attempts and progress only.
solverOutcomeIndex.outcomeIdentity: stable hash of puzzle fingerprint, canonical assembly signature, candidate rank, base failure mode and selected repair route
solverOutcomeIndex.mergePolicy: same stable outcome id is deduplicated and the observation with the best engine progress is retained

pipeline: build manufacturing plan and assembly candidates
validate engine and derive adaptive repair route
run bounded timing/geometry repair until solved or exhausted
optionally compact each candidate result into the persistent solver outcome index

remainingValidation: rebuild fragment/flow indexes from the local corpus using current schemas
accumulate solver-outcomes across reference campaign generation runs
require a minimum observation threshold before learned priors may override diagnostic repair heuristics
eventually condition priors on puzzle/manufacturing features in addition to failure mode
